title: The Matthew Effect
subtitle: To those who have, more will be given.

items.text: The Matthew Effect

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Well, what are you worried about?

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: We own the patent, so what we charge for it is our right! Doesn't matter whether it's sold for $1 or $1000. It's none of their d**ned business.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Let the whiners whine all they like. The law is on our side!

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Well, I'm not going to delay this signing any longer. If you don't want to set this thing to my price, then I can always sell the patent to the Brits instead. You get me?
Wilson Company Office
He slams the phone down.
Sonetto, waiting patiently, at last seizes the opportunity to speak.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mr. Wilson, we are investigators from the St. Pavlov Foundation. As per the contract, please return to headquarters with us.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Yeah … Of course. I fully intend on complying with the Foundation.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: But first I need to take care of some company business. As you can see, I'm in a "little pickle," and things are far from settled here.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: You'll just have to wait a few days more until this contract is finalized.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Don't worry about it. You and your little investigators can put your feet up and relax. We'll be fully covering your travel expenses while you wait.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But …
This isn't what we originally agreed to, Mr. Wilson.
items.edge_label: 这和开始商议的不一样

items.speaker: X
items.text: That's right, Mr. Wilson. More importantly, the "Storm" does not wait.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Think I don't know that? That's why I've got to hurry up and sell these patents.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Anyway, it's not like you've got any choice in the matter. Or didn't you read the rider?
Wilson smiles sharply.
X casts a confused glance at Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: … There is indeed a clause. 17.2.2: The Foundation is required to assist in the transfer of property from Wilson Pharmaceuticals …

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We will fulfill our obligations.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But Mr. Wilson, if the "Storm" comes, it will be too late.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Relax, little Miss Foundation. It won't take long.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: After my acquisition is complete, I'll honor the contract. I've got my reasons for this, you'll see.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Till then, I've got work to do. Now, get out of here. Go make yourselves comfortable.
The protesters are still marching outside the office building.

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: Cancel this sale! Protect patient rights!!!
X rolls up the window.

items.speaker: X
items.text: This Wilson guy is pretty smart. I can't believe he got us to sign that rider with the Foundation.
Do we just keep waiting like this?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, I do understand your concern.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But according to the terms of the rider, all we can do now is wait.

items.speaker: X
items.text: But Mr. Wilson didn't even give us a definitive timeline.

items.speaker: X
items.text: What are we going to do? Just wait around until the very last moment before the "Storm"?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: That won't be necessary.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: If need be, I'll ask headquarters for permission to transfer him forcibly.

items.speaker: X
items.text: I'm not sure if that will do much to help.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Seems like headquarters was fully aware of Wilson's "little pickle." But they still chose to make this agreement with him.

items.speaker: X
items.text: … Hmm, I see. Haha, so that's how it is.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Ms. Sonetto, I think we've misunderstood the true purpose of our mission.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What do you mean?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Sure, Wilson is an arcanist, but he's a businessman first.

items.speaker: X
items.text: He is just trying to seek the best outcome for his interests.

items.speaker: X
items.text: So, after learning about the "Storm," he chose to join up with the Foundation. But he also chose to sell off his patents, and he's aiming on getting the most he can.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Of course, he had to expect that this would cause a lot of trouble. But as long as he's the rightful patent owner, he can sell it to anyone and for any price.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Then, he prepared his own retreat.
So we're here as security?
items.edge_label: 所以我们是来当保安的？

items.speaker: X
items.text: Mm-hm. You've got it, Ms. Vertin. He knew the Foundation would send someone to pick him up; he also knew he could make them stick around using the rider.

items.speaker: X
items.text: So if the situation deteriorates any further, he'll be able to use us as his shield.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mr. X, what do you mean …?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Think about it …

items.speaker: X
items.text: Might he not, for example … make us suppress a riot, if it becomes a threat?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: … Ridiculous!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We will, of course, ensure Mr. Wilson's personal safety, but we are under no obligation to follow his orders.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Ms. Sonetto, I can see why Madam Z warned you about this mission.

items.speaker: X
items.text: The moment you said "Of course," you fell into his trap.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I don't understand …?
Like it or not, he intends to make this part of our mission.
items.edge_label: 他会将这变为我们任务的一部分

items.speaker: X
items.text: Yes. Just follow the chain of events. All he will need to do is demonstrate that it is our job to "assist in the transfer of property" and "protect the mission target," and on principle, we cannot refuse him.
But the contract says nothing about suppressing riots.
items.edge_label: 但这也并非合同明文规定的内容

items.speaker: X
items.text: So then the next part is clear. We've got to find a break in the chain and exploit it, before he passes that buck on to us.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Huh? Why are you all looking at me like that?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry, your analysis was so reasonable that I almost lost my train of thought.
Seems like we must entrust this next part to you, X.
items.edge_label: 这个环节只能交给你了

items.speaker: X
items.text: Wait, are we starting to pass the buck already?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Well, I can probably keep him safe ... But I'm not sure if I'm the right person for the job.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Of course you are, Mr. X, and I must say it is truly an honor to be on this mission with you.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Your insight has been most invaluable to our mission. Truly.
Well, this mission just went from bad to worse.

items.speaker: X
items.text: … I'd better get out of here before you two find more work to give me.

items.speaker: X
items.text: See you later, my heartless friends.
TO BE CONTINUED…
